item.title: WestJet cabin crew approve proposed deal after strike
item.description: WestJet flight attendants on Monday voted to accept a tentative agreement that would boost wages by more than 18% over three years, their union said, after they held a strike that caused hundreds of cancellations earlier this month.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: WestJet flight attendants on Monday voted to accept a tentative agreement that would boost wages by more than 18% over three years, their union said, after they held a strike that caused hundreds of cancellations earlier this month. The airline's flight attendants also secured duty pay premium as part of a broader shift in North America, where cabin crews are challenging compensation structures built mainly around flying time rather than every hour at work. The Canadian Union of Public Employees, which represents about 4,400 WestJet flight attendants, had sought compensation from the time members check in for work until they clock out. A premium offered in the tentative agreement would provide additional compensation for previously unpaid time. Air Canada (AC.TO) , American Airlines (AAL.O) , Alaska Air (ALK.N) , Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) and United Airlines (UAL.O) have introduced pay for boarding or other specified ground time, increasing pressure on other carriers to recognize more of the hours attendants spend on duty. The union announced [USN:L4N4400UP TEXT:"a tentative deal"] with Canada's second-largest carrier, which is majority-owned by Onex Corp (ONEX.TO) , on August 3.

item.title: Popularidade de Trump fica em nível recorde de baixa e apoio dos EUA à guerra no Irã cai, diz pesquisa Reuters Ipsos
item.description: A aprovação pública nos Estados Unidos em relação à guerra com o Irã caiu para seu nível mais baixo desde os primeiros dias do conflito, contribuindo para manter a popularidade do presidente Donald Trump em um nível recorde de baixa, mostrou pesquisa da Reuters/Ipsos encerrada na segunda-feira.
item.dc:creator: Jason Lange
item.content:encoded: A aprovação pública nos Estados Unidos em relação à guerra com o Irã caiu para seu nível mais baixo desde os primeiros dias do conflito, contribuindo para manter a popularidade do presidente Donald Trump em um nível recorde de baixa, mostrou pesquisa da Reuters/Ipsos encerrada na segunda-feira. Realizada durante quatro dias, a pesquisa mostrou que 31% dos norte-americanos apoiam a ação militar dos EUA contra o Irã, uma queda em relação aos 37% registrados na rodada de março da Reuters/Ipsos, e aos 34% no início do mês. A queda foi impulsionada por um número menor de pessoas que se identificam como republicanas apoiando o conflito. Cerca de 69% dos entrevistados republicanos apoiam a guerra, em comparação com 77% em março. A guerra vem prejudicando a popularidade de Trump neste ano e, pela segunda pesquisa consecutiva, uma parcela de 33% dos entrevistados aprova o desempenho do republicano na Casa Branca, nível mais baixo na série da Reuters/Ipsos durante o primeiro e o segundo mandato de Trump. Trump disse aos norte-americanos que a guerra -- iniciada com ataques dos EUA e de Israel ao Irã em 28 de fevereiro -- é necessária para impedir que Teerã desenvolva uma arma nuclear. O conflito esfriou nos últimos meses, mas o Irã manteve em vigor um bloqueio às exportações de petróleo da região, o que elevou os preços da gasolina nos EUA a níveis próximos de recordes históricos. Trump prometeu intensificar a pressão econômica sobre o Irã, e o secretário do Tesouro, Scott Bessent, anunciou nesta segunda-feira uma possível ampliação das sanções contra países que mantêm relações comerciais com o Irã, mas não chegou a impor penalidades de fato, sintoma de quão espinhoso o conflito se tornou para o governo. GUERRA PROLONGADA Cerca de 83% da população acredita que a guerra vai se prolongar “por um longo período”, segundo a última pesquisa da Reuters/Ipsos, um aumento em relação aos 80% registrados no início do mês. Trump fez campanha antes das eleições presidenciais de 2024 com as promessas de controlar a inflação e evitar conflitos militares prolongados. Seis meses após o início da guerra com o Irã, os preços da gasolina nos EUA estão mais de um dólar mais altos por galão do que antes da guerra, pesando sobre os aliados republicanos de Trump, que precisam defender maiorias estreitas no Congresso nas eleições de meio de mandato em 3 de novembro. Eleitores independentes preferiram os democratas aos republicanos -- 33% contra 19% -- quando questionados sobre em quem votariam nas eleições para o Congresso. A pesquisa entrevistou 1.215 adultos norte-americanos em todo o país e tem margem de erro de 3 pontos percentuais para mais ou para menos.

item.title: Poulter unsure about his future with LIV Golf
item.description: England's Ian Poulter said on Monday he hoped LIV Golf remained afloat next year but was unsure about his own future with the breakaway circuit he has been with since its launch in 2022.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: England's Ian Poulter said on Monday he hoped LIV Golf remained afloat next year but was unsure about his own future with the breakaway circuit he has been with since its launch in 2022. Poulter, a five-times Ryder Cup champion, made the admission in a lengthy social media post that came one day after [USN:L6N44E0XU TEXT:"LIV's 2026 season"] concluded earlier than originally planned, calling his time there "one hell of a ride." "It would be a real shame if LIV 2.0 doesn’t happen," Poulter, 50, said on Instagram. "There are players who would love a strong global platform to play on and countries and fans who want us back. Some players will stay, some may go. "As for me, I may stay or take some time off. I genuinely haven’t decided yet." LIV Golf wrapped up its season a week earlier than planned and this month said it had secured a lead investor that will provide a funding boost as it prepares for a future without backing from [USN:L4N41D0Q4 TEXT:"Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund"]. While LIV Golf has signed a term sheet with a [USN:L6N4420XD TEXT:"lead investor"] that would fund the league in 2027, it is a non-binding agreement and has not been finalised. Poulter has never won an individual or team title with LIV but does have 17 career professional wins, including three on the PGA Tour. He was among a handful of big names that took lucrative, big-money contracts in 2022 to make the switch to LIV from the established tours and defended his decision. "LIV gave me a significant opportunity late in my career and I took it," said Poulter. "People make career decisions every day based on opportunity, family and financial security. Professional sport is no different."

item.title: S&P 500 e Nasdaq fecham em baixa por ações do setor de tecnologia; investidores avaliams medidas sobre Irã
item.description: O S&P 500 e o Nasdaq encerraram em baixa nesta segunda-feira, prejudicados pelas ações do setor de tecnologia, enquanto os investidores avaliavam as novas pressões econômicas dos EUA contra o Irã e se preparavam para uma semana que inclui a divulgação dos resultados da Nvidia e um relatório sobre a inflação que será acompanhado de perto.
item.dc:creator: Saeed Azhar, Purvi Agarwal, Niket Nishant
item.content:encoded: O S&P 500 e o Nasdaq encerraram em baixa nesta segunda-feira, prejudicados pelas ações do setor de tecnologia, enquanto os investidores avaliavam as novas pressões econômicas dos EUA contra o Irã e se preparavam para uma semana que inclui a divulgação dos resultados da Nvidia e um relatório sobre a inflação que será acompanhado de perto. O governo Trump anunciou nesta segunda-feira uma possível ampliação das sanções contra países que mantêm relações comerciais com o Irã, como parte do que chamou de “Dia D econômico”, mas não chegou a impor penalidades de fato. As ações do setor de chips sofreram forte correção, arrastando para baixo o índice Philadelphia SE Semiconductor (.SOX) . A Nvidia (NVDA.O) caiu 2,9%, a Micron Technology (MU.O) tombou 5,8% e a Broadcom (AVGO.O) registrou queda de 2,6%, pressionando o índice de Tecnologia da Informação do S&P 500 (.SPLRCT) . O otimismo em relação às empresas de tecnologia também foi afetado pela crescente oposição política aos data centers de IA. O governador do Texas, Greg Abbott, fez uma das advertências mais contundentes já feitas por um republicano ao setor de IA, afirmando que as empresas de data centers “cavaram sua própria cova” e merecem a reação negativa que estão enfrentando por não terem conseguido o apoio da comunidade, informou o Axios no domingo. Neste mês, Abbott ordenou uma pausa nas aprovações de novos projetos de data centers por meio do processo estadual de interconexão à rede elétrica, citando preocupações de que um aumento na demanda por eletricidade pudesse ameaçar a confiabilidade do sistema, em um momento em que a oposição aos projetos está crescendo. “A maior preocupação que temos é a retórica agressiva que estamos começando a ouvir de políticos sobre IA e data centers”, disse Ohsung Kwon, estrategista-chefe de ações do Wells Fargo. “Temos destacado isso como um grande risco à medida que nos aproximamos das eleições de meio de mandato.” No entanto, o setor financeiro (.SPSY) registrou alta, com o JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) subindo 1,4% e a Visa (V.N) subindo 3%. Essas empresas também mantiveram o índice Dow Jones de blue-chip em alta. O Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) subiu 0,26%, para 53.417,16 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) caiu 0,28%, para 7.652,86 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) recuou 0,76%, para 25.980,19 pontos. ATENÇÃO VOLTADA PARA O DISCURSO DE WARSH EM JACKSON HOLE Preocupações com o aumento vertiginoso da dívida pública levaram o rendimento dos títulos de 30 anos ao nível mais alto em 19 anos antes de o Tesouro anunciar medidas de apoio na semana passada. A CNBC informou nesta segunda-feira que o secretário do Tesouro, Scott Bessent, poderia recorrer à Conta Geral do departamento, de quase US$1 trilhão, para ajudar a financiar a recompra de títulos. No entanto, o rendimento dos títulos do Tesouro dos EUA de 30 anos permaneceu acima de 5%. Essa turbulência intensificou o foco no discurso do chair do Federal Reserve, Kevin Warsh, no simpósio de Jackson Hole na sexta-feira, onde os investidores buscarão pistas sobre a interpretação dos formuladores de políticas em relação aos esforços de resgate do Tesouro. Os resultados trimestrais da gigante de IA Nvidia devem ser outro catalisador importante para os mercados. Qualquer sinal de desaceleração no crescimento poderia reacender as preocupações com as valorizações exageradas. “A Nvidia precisa impressionar para manter um dos pilares do mercado de ações estável, e Warsh precisa trazer clareza sobre as taxas de juros para manter o outro pilar estável”, disse Richard Reyle, diretor de investimentos da Questar Capital Partners. Os mercados também acompanharão o relatório de Gastos com Consumo Pessoal (PCE), o indicador de inflação preferido do Fed, com divulgação prevista para quarta-feira. Isso se dará após um relatório de inflação ao consumidor favorável divulgado neste mês, que reduziu as chances de um aumento imediato nas taxas de juros. Os operadores esperam um aumento de 25 pontos-base até o final de 2026, de acordo com dados da LSEG. Separadamente, o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, alertou que as tarifas sobre carros, caminhões e peças automotivas do Canadá seriam aumentadas para 50% a partir de 1º de janeiro, após o fracasso das negociações comerciais no fim de semana. As montadoras Ford (F.N) e General Motors (GM.N) caíram 3,3% e 1,1%, respectivamente, enquanto a empresa de transporte rodoviário J.B. Hunt Transport (JBHT.O) registrou queda de cerca de 5,7%.

item.title: US military says it struck vessel in Eastern Pacific, killing two
item.description: The U.S. military said on Monday two people had been killed in a strike it launched on a vessel in the Eastern Pacific over the weekend, the latest in a series of similar attacks that Washington says target "narco-terrorists" but human rights groups say amount to extrajudicial killings.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: The U.S. military said on Monday two people had been killed in a strike it launched on a vessel in the Eastern Pacific over the weekend, the latest in a series of similar attacks that Washington says target "narco-terrorists" but human rights groups say amount to extrajudicial killings. FURTHER DETAILS: The U.S. Southern Command said the strike was carried out on Sunday. "Confirmed intelligence revealed the vessel's active involvement in narco-trafficking. The operation killed two narco-terrorists," it said on X. It did not identify the individuals targeted or specify their affiliation to any group beyond saying the vessel was "operating along established narco-trafficking routes in the Eastern Pacific." President Donald Trump's administration has been [USN:L1N42R01S TEXT:"striking vessels"] that it accuses of transporting narcotics since September 2025. Sunday's strike marked the first in more than two months. The U.S. military's strikes on such vessels have killed more than 200 people. Human Rights Watch, Amnesty International, and independent [USN:L1N3W20V1 TEXT:"U.N. experts"] have called the strikes unlawful extrajudicial killings.

item.description: Um vídeo em que Leonel Brizola, ex-governador do Rio Grande do Sul e do Rio de Janeiro, critica o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro é uma versão adulterada de uma participação do político gaúcho em um debate presidencial em 1989.

item.content:encoded: Um vídeo em que Leonel Brizola, ex-governador do Rio Grande do Sul e do Rio de Janeiro, critica o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro é uma versão adulterada de uma participação do político gaúcho em um debate presidencial em 1989. Aqui estão os principais detalhes: Posts mostram um vídeo em que Brizola acusa Bolsonaro de mandar em milícias e afirma que ele é “o único bandido corrupto que seus eleitores consideram honesto”. “Em 1989, Brizola já alertava sobre Bolsonaro”, diz a legenda da publicação. A gravação original é da participação de Brizola no debate do SBT no primeiro turno da eleição presidencial de 1989. O político não mencionou o ex-presidente em nenhum momento do programa. Em 1989, Bolsonaro era vereador no Rio de Janeiro, conforme sua biografia no site da Câmara dos Deputados. Veredicto: Alterado digitalmente. O vídeo original é um trecho de um debate presidencial em que Brizola não citou Bolsonaro. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. item.title: Tesoro EEUU mantendrá calendario de subastas de deuda a pesar del aumento de las recompras: Bessent
item.description: El Tesoro de Estados Unidos seguirá adelante con sus subastas de deuda programadas habitualmente, incluidas las de bonos a largo plazo, a pesar de su decisión de aumentar el volumen de recompra de títulos con vencimientos de entre 10 y 30 años, dijo el lunes el secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent.
item.dc:creator: David Lawder, Dan Burns
item.content:encoded: El Tesoro de Estados Unidos seguirá adelante con sus subastas de deuda programadas habitualmente, incluidas las de bonos a largo plazo, a pesar de su decisión de aumentar el volumen de recompra de títulos con vencimientos de entre 10 y 30 años, dijo el lunes el secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent. Al ser preguntado en una rueda de prensa centrada en las sanciones a Irán sobre los planes del Tesoro respecto a las recompras de bonos y el volumen de las subastas de cara al futuro, Bessent dijo que el departamento "continuará con nuestro programa habitual de subastas" anunciado este mes. Añadió que el Tesoro aún no ha comprado ningún bono en el marco de las recompras ampliadas, que comenzarán el 10 de septiembre para los títulos a 10 y 20 años. Bessent, un ex gestor de fondos de cobertura con experiencia en deuda soberana y mercados de divisas, sorprendió la semana pasada al mercado de bonos de todo el mundo al anunciar que el Tesoro duplicaría el volumen de sus recompras trimestrales de deuda a más largo plazo después de que sus rendimientos alcanzaran los niveles más altos en casi dos décadas. La táctica del responsable del Tesoro contribuyó a reducir los rendimientos de los bonos a 10 años y de los bonos a 20 y 30 años durante un breve periodo de tiempo, lo que proporcionó al Gobierno cierto respiro frente a los elevados retornos que están disparando rápidamente los costos del servicio de la deuda federal. Sin embargo, los rendimientos de los bonos con vencimientos más largos se habían recuperado en gran medida de esas caídas al final de la semana. El lunes registraban un ligero descenso. Bessent también advirtió el lunes a los países que cortaran sus vínculos comerciales con Irán, amenazándolos con sanciones secundarias si no lo hacían, aunque sin llegar a imponer sanciones severas. Advirtió de que esta semana se produciría un importante anuncio de sanciones relacionado con un banco. No ha indicado la fuente de financiación para las recompras del Tesoro, pero la Cuenta General del Tesoro (TGA, por su sigla en inglés) en la Reserva Federal constituye una de las fuentes. Recurrir a esa cuenta evitaría la necesidad de financiar las recompras mediante la emisión de nuevos bonos del Tesoro a más corto plazo, pero mermaría las reservas de efectivo del país. A diferencia de la Fed, el Tesoro no tiene la capacidad de crear dinero a voluntad, por lo que debe financiar las recompras con los recursos de tesorería existentes o solicitar préstamos. Cualquier préstamo adicional debería realizarse a plazos más cortos para no socavar el objetivo de las recompras, que es impulsar la liquidez en el mercado de bonos a más largo plazo. La TGA es, en esencia, la cuenta corriente del Gobierno federal, que se utiliza para sufragar las operaciones diarias del Gobierno, como los salarios de los funcionarios federales, los contratos de defensa y las obligaciones del Tesoro en concepto de intereses y capital. El miércoles pasado ascendía a unos 940.000 millones de dólares. El Tesoro ha reforzado la TGA este año, en parte para pagar unos 166.000 millones de dólares en reembolsos que debe a los importadores, después de que la Corte Suprema del país dictaminara este año que una parte importante de los aranceles a la importación del presidente Donald Trump eran ilegales. Durante el último año, ha registrado un promedio de unos 840.000 millones de dólares, la cifra más alta jamás registrada, salvo durante su rápido aumento durante la pandemia de COVID-19. Un TGA más elevado podría servir de colchón en caso de que los demócratas tomaran el control del Congreso en las elecciones de mitad de legislatura e intentaran utilizar el plazo del techo de deuda como palanca para obtener concesiones de la Casa Blanca.

item.title: Lula's campaign considers curbing on independent contractors in potential new term
item.description: The Brazilian government is evaluating mechanisms to curb the use of workers hired as legal entities rather than employees in a potential reelection of President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, Finance Minister Dario Durigan said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Brazilian government is evaluating mechanisms to curb the use of workers hired as legal entities rather than employees in a potential reelection of President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, Finance Minister Dario Durigan said on Monday. The plan could minimize Brazil's pension deficit, and provide higher social security protection for workers, Durigan told Broadcast, the news service of local newspaper Estadao. "A company that has 80% of its workforce employed as independent contractors, you may eventually require that firm to make a social security contribution," he said. Workers hired as legal entities often earn higher gross pay, while firms typically benefit from lower labor costs because they are not required to pay payroll taxes, severance-fund contributions or other benefits. Durigan was introduced by Broadcast as a representative of Lula's presidential campaign, who will seek reelection in the upcoming October vote. Durigan also advocated for a corporate taxation review, citing discussions over payroll taxes and the interest on equity, a type of shareholder remuneration.

item.title: Ibovespa avança em pregão com Braskem e Yduqs sob holofotes
item.description: O Ibovespa fechou em alta nesta segunda-feira, apoiado principalmente pelo forte avanço da Vale, em pregão com noticiário corporativo intenso, incluindo decisão da Braskem de pedir recuperação extrajudicial e anúncio entre Yduqs e Afya sobre conversas para possível combinação de negócios.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: O Ibovespa fechou em alta nesta segunda-feira, apoiado principalmente pelo forte avanço da Vale, em pregão com noticiário corporativo intenso, incluindo decisão da Braskem de pedir recuperação extrajudicial e anúncio entre Yduqs e Afya sobre conversas para possível combinação de negócios. Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) subiu 0,51%, a 171.906,72 pontos, abandonando a fraqueza dos primeiros negócios, quando recuou a 169.330,39. Na máxima do dia, alcançou 173.109,43 pontos. O volume financeiro somou R$25,33 bilhões. De acordo com analistas do Itaú BBA, o Ibovespa está em recuperação após as quedas recentes e perto de sair da tendência de baixa. "Porém, até que sejam superados os 173.000 pontos (no fechamento), esse movimento deverá ser interpretado como um repique dentro da tendência principal de baixa", afirmaram no relatório Diário do Grafista. Na última sexta-feira, o Ibovespa [USN:L6N44I12B TEXT:"avançou"] 1,85%, a 171.031,73 pontos, cravando três altas seguidas e acumulando alta de 2,45% na semana. No mês, porém, o desempenho permanece com sinal negativo. Mesmo com a alta nesta sessão, ainda cai 3,42%. A pauta da segunda-feira também incluiu [USN:L6N44L0KX TEXT:"pesquisa"] BTG/Nexus mostrando que a vantagem numérica do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) em um eventual segundo turno da eleição presidencial contra o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) diminuiu para 1 ponto percentual. Ambos seguem em empate técnico. Na visão do chefe de alocação de investimentos e sócio da AW Capital, Gabriel Magno, o levantamento apoiou o tom positivo na bolsa paulista, uma vez que corrobora um cenário de eleição mais acirrada. DESTAQUES VALE ON (VALE3.SA) subiu 2,8%, endossada pelo avanço dos futuros do [USN:L6N44L0K5 TEXT:"minério de ferro"] na China, em meio a novos sinais de estímulo de Pequim e pelas expectativas de uma demanda mais forte antes do pico da temporada de construção, em setembro. O contrato mais negociado na Bolsa de Mercadorias de Dalian fechou o pregão do dia com alta de 1,27%. CSN MINERAÇÃO ON (CMIN3.SA) avançou 1,19%. PETROBRAS PN recuou 2,31%, em dia de queda do petróleo no exterior , tendo ainda como pano de fundo o pedido de recuperação extrajudicial da Braskem, na qual a petrolífera divide o controle com a IG4 Capital. ITAÚ UNIBANCO PN fechou com acréscimo de 0,34%, em dia positivo para os bancos do Ibovespa. BRADESCO PN subiu 0,18%, BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) avançou 0,92% e SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT encerrou em alta de 0,34%. YDUQS ON (YDUQ3.SA) disparou 12,83%, após o grupo de educação informar que mantém [USN:L1N44L0LD TEXT:"tratativas"] "em estágio inicial" com a Afya (AFYA.O) para uma possível combinação de negócios envolvendo as empresas. BRASKEM caiu 6,71% após divulgar que seu conselho de administração aprovou o ajuizamento de pedido de [USN:L1N44L0DH TEXT:"recuperação extrajudicial"] da petroquímica e de certas controladas para reestruturar dívidas de cerca de US$10,9 bilhões. O plano inclui uma possível capitalização via oferta de ações. Em linha com o regulamento da bolsa, a B3 informou que as ações da companhia serão excluídas de seus índices após o encerramento do pregão regular da terça-feira. USIMINAS PNA saltou 8,7%, tendo no radar nota do colunista Lauro Jardim, de O Globo, de que o acionista controlador Ternium (TX.N) quer fechar o capital da companhia. Procurada pela Reuters, a Ternium não comentou de imediato. CSN ON (CSNA3.SA) , que detém ações da Usiminas, avançou 7,72%. Ainda no setor, GERDAU PN (GGBR4.SA) perdeu 0,05%. SUZANO ON (SUZB3.SA) valorizou-se 3%, respaldada por relatório de analistas do Bank of América, que elevaram a recomendação dos papéis para compra ante neutra, bem como o preço-alvo das ações para R$61. ONCOCLÍNICAS ON (ONCO3.SA) , que não faz parte do Ibovespa, disparou 32,17%, a R$1,52, em sessão na véspera de um [USN:L6N44L0VP TEXT:"julgamento"] na Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (CVM) de recursos contra o entendimento de área técnica da autarquia sobre a não realização de uma oferta pública de aquisição (OPA) das ações da companhia.

item.title: Netanyahu afirma que Irán intentó asesinar a uno de sus hijos
item.description: El primer ministro israelí, Benjamin Netanyahu, afirmó el lunes que Irán había intentado asesinar a uno de sus hijos, pero no dio detalles sobre cuándo tuvo lugar el supuesto complot, a qué hijo iba dirigido ni hasta qué punto estuvo cerca de llevarse a cabo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El primer ministro israelí, Benjamin Netanyahu, afirmó el lunes que Irán había intentado asesinar a uno de sus hijos, pero no dio detalles sobre cuándo tuvo lugar el supuesto complot, a qué hijo iba dirigido ni hasta qué punto estuvo cerca de llevarse a cabo. La acusación de Netanyahu pone de relieve el recrudecimiento de las tensiones desde que comenzó en febrero la guerra de Estados Unidos e Israel contra Irán, durante la cual murieron el líder supremo, el ayatolá Alí Jamenei, y otros altos dirigentes iraníes. Netanyahu, cuya coalición va a la zaga en las encuestas de opinión a dos meses de las elecciones generales de octubre, hizo esta afirmación en una entrevista telefónica con el Canal 14 de Israel. Respondía así a reportes de que uno de los organismos de seguridad israelíes se había negado a proporcionar protección a un rival político de cara a las elecciones nacionales. "En cuanto a mis hijos (...) Aquí, creo que hay algo bastante increíble, sí. Irán puso en el punto de mira a uno de mis hijos. Irán intentó matar, asesinar a uno de mis hijos", declaró Netanyahu al canal conservador, conocido por su cobertura favorable al Gobierno. "Irán intentó asesinar a uno de mis hijos y, por lo tanto, esta protección de seguridad no es un lujo", afirmó, sin dar más detalles sobre el supuesto complot. No quedó claro de inmediato a cuál de sus hijos se refería. El hijo mayor de Netanyahu, Yair, vive en Miami. La misión de Irán ante Naciones Unidas en Nueva York no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios sobre la acusación. Netanyahu también afirmó que le había dicho al jefe de la agencia de seguridad Shin Bet, David Zini, que se debía proporcionar la seguridad adecuada a cualquier candidato a primer ministro. Los medios de comunicación israelíes habían informado anteriormente que Zini se había negado a proporcionar protección al exjefe militar Gadi Eisenkot y había comunicado a la autoridad electoral del país que no existía ningún complot para atentar contra él. Se prevé que el partido de Eisenkot obtenga el mayor número de escaños en las elecciones, aunque los gobiernos israelíes suelen formarse mediante coaliciones entre varios grupos, en lugar de que un único partido consiga por sí solo la mayoría parlamentaria.

item.title: US Treasury to stick to debt auction schedule despite bigger buybacks, Bessent says
item.description: The U.S. Treasury will continue with its regularly scheduled debt auctions, including for long-dated bonds, despite its move to increase buyback sizes of 10- to 30-year securities, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: David Lawder, Dan Burns
item.content:encoded: The U.S. Treasury will continue with its regularly scheduled debt auctions, including for long-dated bonds, despite its move to increase buyback sizes of 10- to 30-year securities, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Monday. Asked at a news conference focused on Iran sanctions about Treasury's plans for bond buybacks and auction sizes going forward, Bessent said the department would "continue with our regular program of auctions" [USN:L1N4400V0 TEXT:"announced in early August"]. He added that the Treasury hasn't purchased any bonds yet in the enlarged buybacks, which will start on September 10 for 10- and 20-year securities. Bessent, a former hedge fund manager with extensive experience in sovereign debt and currency markets, last week surprised global bond investors by announcing the Treasury would [USN:L1N44G0GD TEXT:"double the size"] of its quarterly repurchases of longer-dated bonds after their yields reached the highest levels in nearly two decades. The Treasury chief's tactic helped bring down yields on 10-year Treasury notes and 20- and 30-year bonds for a short time, providing the administration some relief from the high bond yields that are rapidly driving up federal debt service costs. But yields on the longer-dated maturities had largely retraced those drops by the end of the week. They were down modestly on Monday. Bessent also warned countries on Monday to [USN:L1N44L0FC TEXT:"cut business ties to Iran"], threatening them with secondary sanctions if they failed to do so, while stopping short of imposing severe penalties. He warned that a major sanctions announcement related to a bank would happen later this week. He has not indicated the funding source for the Treasury buybacks, but the Treasury General Account at the Federal Reserve provides one source. Tapping that account would spare the need to finance the buybacks by issuing new, shorter-dated Treasuries, but would eat into the nation's cash reserves. Unlike the Fed, the Treasury does not have the ability to create money at will, so it needs to pay for the buybacks from existing cash resources or borrow the funds. Any additional borrowing would need to be done at shorter maturities so as not to upend the goal of the buybacks, which is to boost liquidity in the market for longer-dated bonds. The TGA is essentially the federal government's checking account, used to pay for daily government operations like federal worker salaries, defense contracts and Treasury interest and principal obligations. It stood at about $940 billion as of last Wednesday. Treasury has beefed up the TGA this year in part to pay for some $166 billion of refunds it owes to importers after the U.S. Supreme Court earlier this year ruled a major chunk of President Donald Trump's import tariffs [USN:L1N3ZG0JK TEXT:"were illegal"]. Over the last year it has averaged about $840 billion, the highest ever outside of its rapid run-up during the COVID-19 pandemic. A bigger TGA could act as a cushion in the event Democrats take control of Congress in the midterm elections and try to use a debt ceiling deadline as leverage to extract concessions from the White House. INCREASINGLY INTERVENTIONIST APPROACH Bessent has argued the upswing in yields to nearly two-decade highs was unwarranted against the vibrancy of the U.S. economy. He also pointed to the Trump administration's plans to curtail government spending that has driven the collective U.S. IOU to the world north of [USN:L6N44G17Z TEXT:"$40 trillion"]. In the latest of Bessent's increasingly interventionist maneuvers, the Treasury last week said it would double its bond buybacks in the 10- to 30-year sector over the next quarter to at least $4 billion per operation. Bessent, who earlier this month executed the first joint intervention in the Japanese yen in 15 years, said last week that his objective was to support liquidity in an area of the market that is thinly traded, especially in August, while having to compete with a large volume of corporate issuance at higher yields, including for artificial intelligence infrastructure.

item.title: Rockies place LHP Kyle Freeland (neck) on 15-day IL
item.description: The Colorado Rockies placed veteran left-hander Kyle Freeland on the 15-day injured list with a pinched nerve in his neck and selected the contract of right-hander Blake Adams from Triple-A Albuquerque.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Colorado Rockies placed veteran left-hander Kyle Freeland on the 15-day injured list with a pinched nerve in his neck and selected the contract of right-hander Blake Adams from Triple-A Albuquerque. Freeland, 33, departed his start against the Los Angeles Dodgers on Wednesday in the fourth inning with discomfort in his left arm caused by the pinched nerve. He is 4-10 with a 6.37 ERA in 23 starts this season. In 10 major league seasons, all with the Rockies, the Denver native is 69-100 with a 4.71 ERA in 259 appearances (254 starts). Adams, 25, is set to make his major league debut. In 25 appearances (two starts) between Double-A and Triple-A this season, Adams is 3-5 with a 6.52 ERA. The 13th-round draft pick in 2022 has spent five seasons in the minor leagues. --Field Level Media

item.title: Popularidad Trump, en mínimos históricos mientras cae apoyo EEUU a guerra contra Irán: sondeo Reuters/Ipsos
item.description: El apoyo de la opinión pública estadounidense a la guerra con Irán ha caído a su nivel más bajo desde los primeros días del conflicto, lo que ha contribuido a que la popularidad del presidente Donald Trump se mantenga en mínimos históricos, según una encuesta de Reuters/Ipsos que finalizó el lunes.
item.dc:creator: Jason Lange
item.content:encoded: El apoyo de la opinión pública estadounidense a la guerra con Irán ha caído a su nivel más bajo desde los primeros días del conflicto, lo que ha contribuido a que la popularidad del presidente Donald Trump se mantenga en mínimos históricos, según una encuesta de Reuters/Ipsos que finalizó el lunes. La encuesta, realizada durante cuatro días, reveló que solo el 31% de los estadounidenses apoya la acción militar de Estados Unidos contra Irán, lo que supone un descenso respecto al 37% registrado en una encuesta de Reuters/Ipsos de marzo y al 34% de principios de este mes. Este descenso se debe a que son menos los que se identifican como republicanos y respaldan el conflicto. Alrededor del 69% de los encuestados republicanos apoya la guerra, frente al 77% de marzo. La guerra ha lastrado la popularidad de Trump este año y, por segunda encuesta consecutiva, solo el 33% de los consultados afirmó que aprobaba la actuación del republicano en la Casa Blanca, el nivel más bajo registrado en los sondeos desde el primer o el segundo mandato de Trump. Alrededor del 83% de la población cree que la guerra se prolongará "durante un largo periodo de tiempo", según la encuesta de Reuters/Ipsos, lo que supone un aumento respecto al 80% previamente en el mes. La encuesta se realizó entre 1.215 adultos estadounidenses de todo el país y tuvo un margen de error de 3 puntos porcentuales.

item.title: German state leader urges joint action to avert Volkswagen plant closures
item.description: Volkswagen's stakeholders must work together on solutions for the auto group in order to shield industry in its home state, the state premier of Lower Saxony said on Monday, as the company tries to avoid plant closures.
item.dc:creator: Rachel More
item.content:encoded: Volkswagen's stakeholders must work together on solutions for the auto group in order to shield industry in its home state, the state premier of Lower Saxony said on Monday, as the company tries to avoid plant closures. "Lower Saxony is automotive country ... and this must remain so," State Premier Olaf Lies said at the VW factory in Hanover, one of five belonging to the group that are facing possible closure. Lies, who sits on the company's supervisory board together with the owner families and labour representatives, spoke ahead of a series of workers' assemblies this week, during which staff will have their first chance to question CEO Oliver Blume on his proposed restructuring. Blume has warned that some 50,000 job cuts are needed to make the carmaker competitive, on top of 50,000 already agreed across the group, which is battling to cut costs to address Chinese competition and billions in U.S. tariff costs. The supervisory board has blocked key elements of his restructuring and is next set to meet on September 4, according to sources familiar with the matter. "Now it is important to me that we find joint solutions," Lies said. Works council chief Daniela Cavallo, who speaks on behalf of Volkswagen's German workforce and also sits on the supervisory board, said the scale of the challenge was clear but reiterated her opposition to plant closures or compulsory redundancies. "A programme for the future can't be created or sustained simply by talking about reducing labour costs, cutting staff, and questioning the viability of locations," Cavallo said in Hanover. "Where is our company actually headed?"

item.title: WikiHow sues OpenAI for copyright infringement over AI training
item.description: Do-it-yourself website WikiHow sued OpenAI in Manhattan federal court for allegedly misusing its instructional material to train its popular chatbot ChatGPT.
item.dc:creator: Blake Brittain
item.content:encoded: Do-it-yourself website WikiHow sued OpenAI in Manhattan federal court for allegedly misusing its instructional material to train its popular chatbot ChatGPT. WikiHow's lawsuit , filed on Friday, said that the AI company scraped thousands of its how-to articles to help train ChatGPT to respond to human prompts. The lawsuit is part of a wave of cases brought by publishers, authors and other copyright holders against AI companies over the alleged misuse of their material to train chatbots like ChatGPT, Anthropic's Claude, Meta's Llama and Google's Gemini. An OpenAI spokesperson said on Monday that the company's AI models are "trained on publicly available data and grounded in fair use." Spokespeople and attorneys for wikiHow did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the new lawsuit on Monday. WikiHow is a crowdsourced platform that hosts instructions for DIY projects. The lawsuit said that OpenAI copied more than 11,000 of its articles without permission to train its GPT large language models. WikiHow also said that ChatGPT reproduces its text in response to user prompts and threatens to displace its market. "Having ingested wikiHow’s articles, those models now produce competing how-to content on the same subjects, at a fraction of the time, effort, and cost of researching, writing, and editing a wikiHow article," the lawsuit said. "The substitution cuts wikiHow’s revenue and, over time, its reason to keep producing the articles at all." The lawsuit alleges OpenAI infringed more than 1,200 of wikiHow's copyrights. WikiHow requested an unspecified amount of monetary damages and a court order blocking OpenAI from infringing its copyrights. The case is WikiHow Inc v. OpenAI Inc, U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, No. 1:26-cv-07171. For WikiHow: Rohit Nath and Alejandra Salinas of Susman Godfrey For OpenAI: attorney information not yet available

item.title: Report: Yankees to recall Justin Topa after Brendan Beck optioned
item.description: The New York Yankees optioned right-hander Brendan Beck to Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre, with the New York Post reporting that right-hander Justin Topa is expected to be recalled.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New York Yankees optioned right-hander Brendan Beck to Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre, with the New York Post reporting that right-hander Justin Topa is expected to be recalled. Beck, 27, made his major league debut in May and is 0-1 with a 9.45 ERA in two appearances. Topa, 35, was signed as a free agent by the Yankees on Aug. 14 after he was released by the Minnesota Twins, Toronto Blue Jays and Kansas City Royals this season. He has a 1.80 ERA in four Triple-A appearances in the Yankees' system. Over parts of seven major league seasons, Topa is 6-11 with a 4.27 ERA in 172 appearances (one start) for the Milwaukee Brewers (2020-2022), Seattle Mariners (2023) and Twins (2024-26). He was 0-1 with an 8.05 ERA in 23 appearances with Minnesota this season. An additional move will have to be made by the Yankees to get Topa on the 40-man roster. --Field Level Media

item.title: Target apologizes for children's clown Halloween costume after backlash
item.description: Target apologized on Monday and said it had pulled a Halloween costume from sale depicting a circus clown that critics said evoked Blackface and minstrel shows.
item.dc:creator: Nicholas Brown, Neil Kanatt
item.content:encoded:
Target (TGT.N) apologized on Monday and said it had pulled a Halloween costume from sale depicting a circus clown that critics said evoked Blackface and minstrel shows. The product, sold as the "Kids' Glows Under Blacklight Circus Clown Halloween Costume," prompted a backlash on social media, with some consumers saying it resembled a racist caricature.

View this post on Instagram

"As a company, we know we got this wrong, and we are deeply sorry," Target said in a statement. "The costume is offensive and should never have been part of our assortment. It is no longer available for sale." It is the latest optics headache for the U.S. retailer as it tries to right its ship after a stretch of poor sales. The company also faced criticism over its handling of products in its 2023 [USN:L8N37R4OP TEXT:"Pride Collection"], and for changes to its [USN:L3N3OK1Q5 TEXT:"diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives"] in the wake of President Donald Trump's return to the White House. Target declined to comment on who designed the product - which was sold under the retailer's seasonal Hyde and EEK Boutique brand - or the process by which it was green-lit for sale. In its statement, Target said it was "looking closely at how this happened and what needs to change." Some Black shoppers, who felt [USN:L2N3ON0SZ TEXT:"alienated"] after Target's 2025 DEI [USN:L2N3PB0T4 TEXT:"rollbacks"], expressed fresh disappointment on Monday. Sheletta Brundidge, a Minneapolis-area business leader, views the costume as an indirect result of the DEI decision. "You rolled back diversity," she said, "so who's in the room, now, to say 'hey, this is wrong?'" Target acknowledged in its statement the costume was "especially hurtful for our Black guests, team members and partners." Though a Target-owned brand, Hyde and EEK products have been resold on websites of retailers like Walmart (WMT.O) and Amazon (AMZN.O) , and the marketplace Etsy (ETSY.N) . Reuters did not see the item in question on those sites. A Walmart spokeswoman said she had no knowledge of that item being sold. Amazon and Etsy did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Target, which has had back-to-back strong quarters, is beginning to see [USN:L4N44F12R TEXT:"results"] from efforts to cut prices and freshen its merchandise, with new CEO Michael Fiddelke so far earning plaudits from Wall Street. But the company - which cannot compete with Walmart and Costco on price - has little room for error when it comes to managerial or optical missteps, said Brett Husslein, an analyst at Morningstar. "As Target begins to gain traction in repairing its brand reputation, this is exactly the kind of stuff they want to avoid," he said, adding that any headwind - optical, managerial, or macroeconomic - "could lead to further market share losses." Target's shares were up 2.7% in afternoon trading.

item.title: EUA cancelam exercícios conjuntos da Marinha com a Coreia do Sul devido a restrições de efetivos relacionadas à guerra no Irã
item.description: Os Estados Unidos cancelaram um exercício conjunto de desembarque anfíbio previsto para o próximo mês com a Coreia do Sul, informou nesta segunda-feira o Corpo de Fuzileiros Navais de Seul, após Washington alegar restrições à disponibilidade das forças americanas devido à guerra no Irã.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os Estados Unidos cancelaram um exercício conjunto de desembarque anfíbio previsto para o próximo mês com a Coreia do Sul, informou nesta segunda-feira o Corpo de Fuzileiros Navais de Seul, após Washington alegar restrições à disponibilidade das forças americanas devido à guerra no Irã. O Corpo de Fuzileiros Navais dos EUA notificou formalmente sua contraparte sul-coreana em junho sobre a limitação da disponibilidade de forças para o exercício em nível de divisão, conhecido como Ssangyong, informou um porta-voz do Corpo de Fuzileiros Navais da Coreia do Sul em coletiva de imprensa. Os aliados continuam em estreitas consultas sobre a retomada dos exercícios, disse o porta-voz. Ele não especificou quais medidas podem ser tomadas para evitar cancelamentos futuros ou para compensar as oportunidades de treinamento perdidas. As Forças dos EUA na Coreia não responderam imediatamente a um pedido de comentário. Mais tarde nesta segunda-feira, o Departamento de Estado dos EUA informou que o secretário de Estado, Marco Rubio, havia conversado com o ministro das Relações Exteriores da Coreia do Sul, Cho Hyun, sobre uma “série de questões” relacionadas à aliança entre os dois países. Rubio disse a seu homólogo sul-coreano que Washington e Seul precisam manter uma estreita coordenação em assuntos essenciais à aliança, de acordo com um comunicado do Departamento de Estado. O cancelamento do exercício de desembarque anfíbio segue-se à ordem surpresa do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, de reduzir a escala de um exercício militar conjunto anual separado, que terminou na última sexta-feira, citando o custo e a recusa de Seul em participar da guerra contra o Irã. Trump também escreveu em sua plataforma Truth Social que os exercícios “Ulchi Freedom Shield” enviaram “um sinal totalmente inadequado e hostil a um país que, desde que Donald J. Trump assumiu a presidência, tem se mostrado não ameaçador e respeitoso”. Apesar da redução dos exercícios, Pyongyang lançou 10 mísseis balísticos de curto alcance na semana passada e divulgou um comunicado condenando os exercícios. A Coreia do Norte há muito condena esses exercícios conjuntos como ensaios para uma invasão.

item.title: Uber ainda vê espaço para crescer no Brasil
item.description: A Uber prevê uma tendência de crescimento ainda forte no Brasil nos próximos anos, apesar dos atuais 140 milhões de usuários no país, disse a diretora-geral da empresa de transporte urbano por aplicativo, Silvia Penna.
item.dc:creator: Rodrigo Viga Gaier
item.content:encoded: A Uber (UBER.N) prevê uma tendência de crescimento ainda forte no Brasil nos próximos anos, apesar dos atuais 140 milhões de usuários no país, disse a diretora-geral da empresa de transporte urbano por aplicativo, Silvia Penna. "Nosso objetivo é trazer mais produtos", afirmou a executiva em entrevista à Reuters. "Continuamos investindo muito aqui", acrescentou. Para crescer seus negócios no Brasil, a empresa aposta na expansão de seu portfólio. A Uber lançou em março um serviço voltado apenas a mulheres, ampliando gama de produtos desenvolvidos no Brasil e que incluem um focado em adolescentes em que pais de menores de idade podem acompanhar o áudio e o trajeto da corrida. "Esses foram produtos feitos aqui e agora estão mundo a fora", disse Penna. A Uber pretende investir R$2 bilhões nos próximos cinco anos em centros de pesquisa e de desenvolvimento no Brasil, em São Paulo e Rio de Janeiro. A companhia oferece serviços em praticamente todas as cidades brasileiras com pelo menos 100 mil habitantes e cálculos da empresa apontam que cerca 90% dos brasileiros adultos já utilizaram a plataforma de transporte. O centro de tecnologia em São Paulo conta com 700 engenheiros e se encontra em fase de expansão, enquanto o escritório do Rio de Janeiro deve contar com 200 profissionais, disse a executiva. Parte do esforço da empresa em lançar novos serviços está na defesa da liberação do transporte de passageiros por motocicletas na cidade de São Paulo, modalidade que segue combatida pela prefeitura na Justiça. "O Uber Moto é uma realidade do Brasil, a exceção é São Paulo", disse a executiva. "Nos dias que a gente operou em São Paulo, registramos a mesma realidade do Brasil inteiro", acrescentou ela.

item.title: Trump's approval holds at record low as US support for Iran war falls, Reuters Ipsos poll finds
item.description: U.S. public approval of the war with Iran fell to its lowest level since the conflict's early days, helping to hold President Donald Trump's popularity at a record low, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll that closed on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Jason Lange
item.content:encoded: U.S. public approval of the war with Iran fell to its lowest level since the conflict's early days, helping to hold President Donald Trump's popularity at a record low, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll that closed on Monday. The four-day poll showed just 31% of Americans support U.S. military action against Iran, down from 37% in a March Reuters/Ipsos poll and 34% earlier this month. The decline was driven by fewer self-identified Republicans backing the conflict. Some 69% of Republican respondents support the war, compared with 77% in March. The war has been dragging on Trump's public standing this year, and for the second survey in a row just 33% of respondents said they approved of the Republican's performance in the White House, the lowest level in Reuters/Ipsos polls in Trump's first or second term. Trump has told Americans that the war - which started with U.S.-Israeli attacks on Iran on February 28 - is necessary to keep Tehran from developing a nuclear weapon. The conflict has cooled in recent months but Iran has kept in place a de facto blockade of oil exports from the region, which has pushed U.S. gasoline prices near record highs. Trump has vowed to ramp up economic pressure on Iran and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Monday announced a possible expansion of sanctions on countries doing business with the country, but stopped short of actually imposing penalties, a sign of how thorny the conflict has become for the administration. FEARS OF A LONG WAR Some 83% of the country thinks the war will go on "for an extended period of time," the latest Reuters/Ipsos poll found, up from 80% earlier this month. Trump campaigned ahead of the 2024 presidential election on promises to control inflation and avoid lengthy military conflicts. Six months into the war with Iran, U.S. gasoline prices are more than a dollar higher per gallon than they were before the war. That is weighing on Trump's Republican allies who will be defending narrow congressional majorities in the November 3 midterm elections. Independent voters in the poll favored Democrats over Republicans - 33% to 19% - when asked who they would vote for in congressional elections if the election were held today. The poll surveyed 1,215 U.S. adults nationwide and had a margin of error of 3 percentage points in either direction.

item.title: Federer playing Flushing Meadows exhibition in long overdue US Open sendoff
item.description: Roger Federer will make a long-awaited curtain call for his adoring fans at Flushing Meadows on Tuesday as the man who defined a generation of tennis plays in an exhibition event ahead of the U.S. Open singles main draw.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: Roger Federer will make a long-awaited curtain call for his adoring fans at Flushing Meadows on Tuesday as the man who defined a generation of tennis plays in an exhibition event ahead of the U.S. Open singles main draw. His final U.S. Open match in 2019 lacked the romantic sendoff that fans have come to expect for former champions, as the Swiss exited in the quarter-finals with many expecting him to return to play at the event again. But he was absent from the U.S Open in 2020 and played in his final slam at Wimbledon in 2021, leaving the New York tournament he once dominated without a proper farewell. "It really gives me a true opportunity to say thank you, goodbye, which is I think important for some," said Federer, whose five consecutive wins are unmatched by any man in the Open Era. "For me it is, and it's a nice thing to do." Tuesday's exhibition, "US Open: Roger Federer - An Icon Returns to NY," was fetching upwards of $2,000 on Ticketmaster's resale platform on Monday, and the Swiss Maestro said he only hoped he could hit the right notes after a long layoff. "It's nerve-wracking, to be honest. I haven't played a single set in - I don't know - maybe five years. Don't know how it's going to go tomorrow," he told reporters. "There's a lot of uncertainty, but a lot of happiness that I can return." Federer will play alongside fellow retired greats Andy Roddick, Andre Agassi and John McEnroe at Arthur Ashe Stadium, where newly un-retired American Serena Williams is due to play mixed doubles with Carlos Alcaraz earlier in the day. The 44-year-old Williams' return to New York had Flushing Meadows buzzing on Monday, as fans had already begun to flood the plaza to catch some of the singles qualifying tournament. Asked if he would ever consider accepting a wild card to the singles competition, Federer, who is only one year Williams' senior, was emphatic: "No, no, no, no, no, no." "I've got just way too many obstacles and I'm too busy - I'm barely finding time to play any exos," said Federer, who is due to be inducted in the Tennis Hall of Fame on Saturday. "The body is done." The U.S. Open men's and women's singles main draw begins on Sunday.

item.title: Tesla interrompe venda de telhados solares uma década após lançamento
item.description: A Tesla deixou de vender telhas solares em seu site, quase uma década depois que o presidente-executivo, Elon Musk, lançou o produto como uma alternativa mais atraente aos painéis solares.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Tesla deixou de vender telhas solares em seu site, quase uma década depois que o presidente-executivo, Elon Musk, lançou o produto como uma alternativa mais atraente aos painéis solares. A página da Tesla sobre telhas solares agora redireciona para uma oferta de painéis solares. A Tesla não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário. Musk apresentou as telhas em 2016, quando a Tesla buscava adquirir a SolarCity, a empresa de instalação de sistemas solares administrada por seus primos. Em 2021, a empresa havia estabelecido uma meta de 1.000 instalações por semana, mas estimativas do setor indicavam que o número real era bem menor. A estratégia solar da Tesla mudou para os painéis tradicionais, que a empresa produz em sua fábrica em Buffalo, Nova York, e começou a entregar a clientes residenciais neste ano. Musk ainda tem grandes ambições no setor solar. A Tesla apresentou planos no Texas neste mês para uma fábrica de células solares de US$10,1 bilhões nos arredores de Houston. (Por Nichola Groom)

item.title: Exportação de café do Brasil no mês já supera agosto de 2025 com alta de 50%, diz Secex
item.description: A exportação de café verde do Brasil já superou, até a terceira semana do mês, o volume registrado em agosto completo do ano passado, com aumento de mais de 50% na média diária de embarques, de acordo com dados da Secretaria de Comércio Exterior (Secex) publicados nesta segunda-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A exportação de café verde do Brasil já superou, até a terceira semana do mês, o volume registrado em agosto completo do ano passado, com aumento de mais de 50% na média diária de embarques, de acordo com dados da Secretaria de Comércio Exterior (Secex) publicados nesta segunda-feira. No acumulado do mês até o dia 24 de agosto, as exportações somaram 153,8 mil toneladas, ante 142,9 mil toneladas em todo o mês do ano passado. Pela média diária, por dia útil, a exportação somou 10,25 mil toneladas, contra 6,8 mil toneladas em agosto de 2025. O salto apontado nos embarques de café -- em um ano em que o Brasil deve registrar uma colheita recorde -- acontece após exportações mais lentas do que o previsto em julho, uma vez que chuvas atrapalharam os fluxos de colheita. As chuvas que atrapalharam a colheita no maior produtor e exportador global foram fator de suporte nos preços globais. Com a colheita de café do Brasil em estágio mais avançado agora, já superando [USN:S0N44203V TEXT:"90%"] das lavouras, o foco climático se volta para as floradas para a próxima safra. Há expectativa de precipitações "significativas" nesta semana, com volumes mais elevados no Cerrado Mineiro e reflexos nas demais regiões produtoras de arábica, como Sul de Minas, São Paulo e Matas de Minas, disse o analista de Inteligência de Mercado da StoneX, Leonardo Rossetti, em nota nesta segunda-feira. Ele apontou ainda que novas pancadas de chuvas esperadas para o início de setembro podem funcionar como um gatilho para boa parte das floradas nas áreas de café arábica.

item.title: Cameroon federation chief Eto'o backs FIFA's Infantino
item.description: Cameroon's all-time top scorer Samuel Eto'o, president of the country's soccer federation, has defended FIFA chief Gianni Infantino, saying opposition to the Swiss-Italian was related to the timing of next year's elections in the global body.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cameroon's all-time top scorer Samuel Eto'o, president of the country's soccer federation, has defended FIFA chief Gianni Infantino, saying opposition to the Swiss-Italian was related to the timing of next year's elections in the global body. Infantino, up for re-election in March 2027, has been criticised since tabling a [USN:L1N43X04P TEXT:"now abandoned proposal"] to sell off a 20% stake in a commercial body for FIFA tournament rights, with several countries [USN:L1N44008Y TEXT:"withdrawing their support"] for his candidacy. "I think all these things are happening because of the timing. There's an election coming up where Gianni Infantino is standing. All of this has happened because there's an election coming up. That's all there is," Eto'o told CNN in an interview broadcast on Monday. While several regional soccer bodies, including UEFA, AFC and CONCACAF, are weighing whether to move a [USN:L6N44H116 TEXT:"vote of no confidence"] to oust Infantino, African body CAF has [USN:L1N4490XL TEXT:"backed him"]. CAF president Patrice Motsepe said earlier this month that Infantino's future should be decided at the 2027 election, and confirmed that the president still has the support of CAF. Former striker Eto'o, who played for major European clubs like Real Madrid, Barcelona, Inter Milan and Chelsea, said Infantino had changed football, giving opportunities to nations that did not have them before. "The president's job is to take football further, to make all of the nations grow," he said. "He made a proposal. The 211 members were supposed to sit down, debate the issue and let the majority win. But I am convinced that the voices that were raised, those are not the voices of the majority."

item.title: Israel's Netanyahu says Iran tried to kill one of his sons
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Monday that Iran had tried to kill one of his sons, but gave no details about when the alleged plot took place, which son was targeted or how close it came to being carried out.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Monday that Iran had tried to kill one of his sons, but gave no details about when the alleged plot took place, which son was targeted or how close it came to being carried out. Netanyahu's allegation underscores the heightened tensions since the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran began in February, during which Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and other senior Iranian leaders were killed. Netanyahu, whose coalition is trailing in opinion polls two months before an October 27 general election, made the claim in a telephone interview with Israel's Channel 14. He was responding to reports that one of Israel's security agencies had refused to provide protection for a political rival ahead of the nationwide vote. "As for my sons. Here, I think there is something quite unbelievable, yes. Iran targeted one of my sons. Iran tried to kill, to murder one of my sons," Netanyahu told the conservative channel known for its favourable coverage of the government. "Iran tried to murder one of my sons, and therefore this security protection is not a luxury," he said, without providing any further details about the alleged plot or how close it came to being carried out. It was not immediately clear which of his sons he was referring to. Netanyahu's elder son, Yair, lives in Miami. Iran's mission at the United Nations in New York did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the accusation. Netanyahu also said he had told the Shin Bet security agency chief David Zini that appropriate security should be provided for any prime ministerial candidate. Israeli media had reported earlier that Zini declined to provide security for Gadi Eisenkot and told the country's election authority there was no plot to harm him. Eisenkot's party is projected to win the largest number of seats in the election, although Israeli governments are usually formed through coalitions among multiple parties rather than by a single party winning a parliamentary majority outright.

item.title: US ethanol credit prices slump after EPA delays biofuel compliance deadline
item.description: Prices for U.S. ethanol blending credits plunged on Monday to their lowest levels in more than four months, market sources said, after the Environmental Protection Agency said it would extend a September 1 compliance deadline for refiners and rule on long-pending small refinery exemption requests by the end of August.
item.dc:creator: Siddharth Cavale, Shariq Khan
item.content:encoded: Prices for U.S. ethanol blending credits plunged on Monday to their lowest levels in more than four months, market sources said, after the Environmental Protection Agency [USN:S0N3YU01Z TEXT:"said"] it would extend a September 1 compliance deadline for refiners and rule on long-pending small refinery exemption requests by the end of August. Conventional ethanol Renewable Identification Numbers (D6 RINs) traded at $1.75 each at 12:45 p.m. ET, down 34 cents from Friday and their lowest level since April 15, according to Argus Media. The credits had traded as high as $2.50 on July 7. Biomass-based diesel RINs for 2026 were last assessed at around $1.92 each, their weakest level since late April, Argus data showed. Under the Renewable Fuel Standard, a federal program aimed at increasing renewable fuel usage, refiners are required to show they had met their 2025 biofuel blending mandates by September 1, either by generating Renewable Identification Numbers (RINs) through blending biofuels into the nation's fuel supply or by purchasing those credits from other market participants. Jessica Dell, head of U.S. biofuel pricing at Argus Media, said RIN prices lost substantial value again during Monday's session in response to the EPA's impending small refinery exemption decisions. RIN prices had fallen 5% on Friday. The EPA is reviewing 34 exemption petitions, some dating back to July 2024. The timing of those decisions has been a major source of uncertainty for the market, especially after the agency finalized [USN:S0N3YU01Z TEXT:"record-high"] renewable fuel blending requirements for 2026 and 2027 which have added to their compliance burdens, Dell said. Extending the compliance deadline is seen as signaling some form of “RIN relief” for refiners' 2026 and 2027 obligations as well, Scott Irwin, an agricultural economist at the University of Illinois said. Market participants expect the EPA's rulings to free up a significant number of credits. Representatives of the refining and ethanol industries and an analyst estimate that the exemptions could free up between 1.2 billion and 1.8 billion RINs that small refiners could use to meet their 2025 compliance obligations. The EPA had previously indicated it could reallocate 990 million RINs associated with exemptions. One senior trader said RINs collapsed as speculation began of SRE relief at around 1.8 billion, a surprise compared to the roughly 1.3 billion the market had been expecting.

item.title: Tesla stops selling solar roofs a decade after launch
